title: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the online library. You can start your essay with the sentence “The online library is becoming increasingly popular.” You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: The online library is becoming increasingly popular. More and more students and researchers now turn to digital collections rather than walking to a physical reading room. This shift is not a passing trend but a reflection of how deeply the Internet has reshaped the way we learn. There are two main reasons behind its growing appeal. For one thing, an online library allows us to access resources anytime and anywhere. Whether we are sitting at home or waiting for a bus, a single click brings a vast collection of e-books and journals to our screen. For another, it helps us search for information efficiently. Instead of flipping through hundreds of pages, we simply type in a keyword and locate exactly what we need within seconds, which saves an enormous amount of time. In conclusion, the online library owes its popularity to its convenience and efficiency. As technology keeps advancing, I firmly believe that it will play an even more important role in our future study and research.
keyPoints: 首句照抄补背景。开头 The online library is becoming increasingly popular. 一字不改照 抄首句，落实"照抄首句再补背景"；随后 More and more students and researchers... 与 This shift is not a passing trend but... 两句补足背景、点出趋势，完成第一段"照抄首句点题"的功能。

两理由各带说明。There are two main reasons 总起，For one thing... allows us to access resources anytime and anywhere 与 For another... search for information efficiently 并列两条理 由，每条后跟 Whether we are sitting at home... 和 Instead of flipping through hundreds of pages... 的具体说明，兑现"一句一理由配说明"、内容不空。
收拢中心再展望。In conclusion... owes its popularity to its convenience and efficiency 把两条原因收回中心，As technology keeps advancing, I firmly believe... 再加展望收尾，落实"回扣中 心加展望"、首尾照应。
